literal_meaning: সাতটি পুরুষ বা প্রজন্ম (seven generations or ancestors)
figurative_meaning_en: a very long time or for generations
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই গ্রামে আমার পরিবার সাতপুরুষ ধরে বাস করে আসছে।
সাতপুরুষের কষ্টের ফল এখন উপভোগ করছি।
example_sentences_in_english: My family has been living in this village for seven generations.
I'm reaping the benefits of seven generations of hard work.
history: The idiom draws from traditional Bengali concepts of lineage and ancestral continuity, often used in folklore to emphasize enduring family legacies without specific historical events.
note: Commonly used to denote extended periods spanning multiple generations in everyday and literary Bengali.
